cards.name: Vampiric Touch
cards.designIntent: Maintain a distinct DoT to deal delayed damage and support Insanity generation.

upgrade.summary: Apply 4 ticks instead of 3; damage remains 5.

card.text: Apply 4 Touch. If played, return to your hand at turn end.

cards.name: Enter Voidform
cards.designIntent: Hold the earned activation until a strong burst turn.

base.text: Retain. Enter Voidform. Exhaust.
effects: Spend this card's ready charge and enter Voidform until the player's turn ends.

rulesNotes: Generated when the starter relic reaches 10 Insanity; not a permanent starter or reward.
One pending charge at a time. Full hands defer delivery. Copied or recovered cards cannot reuse a spent charge.
Voidform reduces Attack energy costs by 1 (minimum 0; excludes X-cost) and multiplies Attack damage by 1.5.
Insanity stops accumulating while ready or active; it resets when Voidform ends and after combat.

cards.name: Power Word: Fortitude
cards.designIntent: An efficient nonstacking defensive buff; redundant copies become dead draws.

base.text: Gain 2 Dexterity. This benefit does not stack. Unplayable if Fortitude has already granted at least this much Dexterity this combat.
effects: Grant only the difference between 2 and the highest previous Fortitude benefit.
Record the highest Fortitude benefit this combat.

upgrade.summary: Raise the nonstacking benefit from 2 to 3 Dexterity.

card.text: Gain 3 Dexterity. This benefit does not stack. Unplayable if Fortitude has already granted at least this much Dexterity this combat.
effects: Grant only the difference between 3 and the highest previous Fortitude benefit.
Record the highest Fortitude benefit this combat.

rulesNotes: Track Fortitude independently of other Dexterity sources and subsequent Dexterity losses.
Base followed by upgrade grants 2, then only 1 additional Dexterity.
Equal or weaker copies cannot be played; this does not turn the card into a Curse.
Clear contribution tracking after combat.
cards.balanceNotes: The free first copy is intentionally strong; duplicate dead draws are the tradeoff.

card.text: At the end of your turn, gain 2 Insanity.

rulesNotes: Multiple copies stack.
No gain while Voidform is ready or active.

Reaching 10 at end of turn makes Enter Voidform available on the next player turn, subject to hand space.

cards.name: Shadow Word: Madness
cards.designIntent: Establish a permanent unique DoT for synergies and build slow damage scaling through repeated casts.

base.text: Apply 5 Madness to an enemy. Deal damage equal to its Madness.
effects: Add 5 Madness to the selected enemy.
Deal one normal Attack hit using its resulting total Madness as base damage.

upgrade.summary: Spread the 5-stack application to all enemies; damage remains single-target.

card.text: Apply 5 Madness to ALL enemies. Deal damage to the selected enemy equal to its Madness.
effects: Add 5 Madness to all current enemies.
Deal one normal Attack hit to the selected enemy using its resulting total Madness as base damage.

rulesNotes: Madness stacks add together, persist on the enemy, and never tick or decay.
Any positive number of Madness stacks counts as one unique DoT for synergies.
Madness has no duration; duration extension has no effect on it.
Apply stacks before calculating the hit. Normal Attack modifiers and Insanity generation apply.
The upgraded card still requires one enemy target for its damage.
cards.balanceNotes: The upgrade improves immediate setup across enemies rather than raising stack growth. Watch permanent DoT synergy value.

cards.name: Halo
cards.designIntent: Build overlapping waves of sustained area damage with independent player auras.

base.text: Gain a Halo aura. At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies for 3 turns.
effects: Create a separate Halo aura with 3 pulses remaining.
At each player end of turn, deal 3 damage to all current enemies, then consume one pulse.

upgrade.summary: Increase each pulse from 3 to 5 damage; duration stays 3 turns.

card.text: Gain a Halo aura. At the end of your turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies for 3 turns.
effects: Create a separate Halo aura with 3 pulses remaining.
At each player end of turn, deal 5 damage to all current enemies, then consume one pulse.

rulesNotes: First pulse occurs at the end of the casting turn, followed by two more pulses.
Each cast creates a separate aura with its own damage and remaining duration; it does not refresh an existing aura.
Pulses affect enemies present when they trigger, including later summons.
Pulses respect Block, ignore Strength and Voidform damage bonuses, and generate no Insanity.
Halo is not a DoT and cannot be extended by enemy DoT duration effects.
As a Skill, Halo does not trigger Psychic Link or receive the Voidform Attack cost discount.
cards.balanceNotes: Test overlapping auras as sustained area damage alongside Mind Sear burst turns.

art.direction: Actual WoW ability icon inside the shared violet-and-gold card frame.

card.text: Whenever Touch removes enemy HP, heal 2 HP.
